details.title: More Than You Know
details.lead: Vincent Youmans, 1929, words by William Rose and Edward Eliscu. The chorus as it is written, with its last ending, in E♭ major: concert D4 to G5. Each phrase climbs in triplets (B♭, B, C) to a held note; the middle part runs down in eighths. Slow, about 76 a minute.
